description: Source code for a particle system sample application using OpenGL ES 2.0, including shader setup, particle data initialization, rendering, and texture loading.

classes.name: ParticleSystemSample
classes.description: A class representing a particle system sample application, managing shader programs, particle data, rendering, and texture loading.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the particle system to the screen.
